subject.title: Dashboard: distribution — shareable deep links, export/import, dashboard-design skill

question: Should this dashboard distribution stack be sponsored after reworking persistence to SQLite/plugin-state, or should it be split/deferred until the broader dashboard storage and security boundaries are settled?
rationale: The PR crosses bundled dashboard product scope, persistent state ownership, dependency graph authorization, import approval security, and router contract choices that automation should not decide from code alone.

options.title: Require SQLite/storage rework before merge
options.body: Keep the PR open, require a SQLite/plugin-state persistence owner plus scratch-file removal, then re-review security and live proof on the exact rebased head.

options.title: Accept JSON as an explicit exception
options.body: Maintainers may choose to bless workspace.json as a named product artifact, but that needs an explicit migration/doctor plan and security sign-off before merge.

options.title: Split or pause the stack
options.body: Close or pause this cumulative PR if maintainers want dashboard export/import, deep links, and the design workflow reviewed only after the base dashboard stack lands.

recommendation.title: Require SQLite/storage rework before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require a SQLite/plugin-state persistence owner plus scratch-file removal, then re-review security and live proof on the exact rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest adjacent owner for the SQLite persistence precedent and prior dashboard roadmap product/security routing.
